about: v19 grade: one film stock, a narrative temperature arc. Read by tools/grade/grade.py (see its docstring). Targets are CIELAB numbers on the baked asset (before the runtime matte/vignette/grain of css/grade.css and before the scenes' own canvas tints): [value, strength 0..1]. neu = mean a*,b* of near-neutrals (white balance), hi_b / sh_b = b* of the brightest / darkest 10 % (+ warm, - cool), sat = mean chroma, cmax = soft chroma ceiling, black/mean on 0..255 luma.
